THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

You are drawing a comic for English class. The comic shows a famous poem in four pictures. Each picture needs its words from the poem. Four people each have the words for one picture.

THE HISTORY

This comic is about a poem by Langston Hughes. He wrote it as a Black teenager, on a train. The train was crossing the Mississippi River. It came out in 1921.
